Postscript | Senior Full Stack Engineer | REMOTE (US or Canada) | $180k-$200k + Equity

Postscript powers SMS marketing and automated revenue for over 20k Shopify merchants. XXXM revenue. Pushing out new AI-native product lines, including rebuilding our entire platform in rust this year.

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer for our Messaging Channels team with 6+ years of experience and a strong background in SaaS startups. We are language-agnostic. We care most about strong technical instincts, high ownership, and a desire to ship fast across the entire stack.
